title: URP Painterly Shader
intro: A stylized painterly shader built in Unity URP. Creates a hand-painted art style with organic edges that can dissolve and erode — mimicking traditional art techniques in real-time 3D.
overview: This shader creates a stylized, hand-painted art style with organic, painterly edges that can dissolve/erode, mimicking traditional art techniques in real-time 3D. It replaces photorealistic rendering with a gradient-based lighting model, adds brush stroke edge detection, and supports dissolve transitions — giving objects the look of a living painting.

steps.title: Stylized Lighting
items: Replaces smooth photorealistic lighting with stepped, gradient-based shading
Uses artist-controlled gradient textures instead of physically accurate light calculations
Creates that 'cel-shaded' or 'illustrated' look common in games like Genshin Impact or Borderlands

steps.title: Painterly Edge Effects
items: Fresnel detection finds the silhouette/edges of objects
Brush stroke textures add hand-painted texture variation
Triplanar mapping ensures consistent texture appearance from all angles (no UV stretching)
Gives the impression that edges were painted with actual brush strokes

steps.title: Rim Erosion / Dissolve
items: Combines rim lighting with noise textures to create organic edge breakup
Edges can fade to transparency in a painterly, artistic way
Useful for dissolve effects, artistic transitions, or simulating paint wear/aging

thePlugin.title: PROPERTIES & PARAMETERS
thePlugin.description: The shader exposes a full set of artist-friendly properties for tuning the painterly look — from surface texture inputs to fine-grained erosion and brush stroke controls.
howToUse: Texture Maps: Albedo map, normal map
Painterly effect: Custom gradient texture for lighting, guide texture for painterly brush effects
Rim lighting: Color, power, and intensity for edge highlights
Erosion effect: Scale, threshold, and softness for texture-based edge breakup
Brush strokes: Parameters for painterly edge effects
